preconditions.description: Attacker needs sufficient PocongNFT tokens to trigger swapAndLiquify mechanism
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true (default is true)

exploit_hint: 1. Acquire sufficient PocongNFT tokens (at least numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity = 2154 * 10^3 * 10^9). 2. Transfer tokens to the contract address to build up contract balance. 3. Trigger another transfer to activate swapAndLiquify() which swaps half the tokens for ETH and adds liquidity. 4. If _takeLiquidity or addLiquidity are publicly accessible, call them directly to manipulate liquidity pool. 5. Monitor attacker's ETH balance for increase from liquidity manipulation or fee extraction through devWallet transfers.
